ownerDirection: One faction color for decorative lamps; blue ammo, green repair, standardized weapon cores; NSDF cyan rails retained
mode: Built-in ImageGen edit; final composition must mask existing glass/functional glyphs only

jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: UV-LOCKED flat game texture atlas pack. Image 1 is the edit target, four separate atlases in a strict 2x2 grid, division at exactly 50% each axis. TOP LEFT=weapon detail, TOP RIGHT=weapon badge, BOTTOM LEFT=ammo pod, BOTTOM RIGHT=repair pod. Preserve every UV outline, chart, hardware, metal, hazard paint, insignia, seam, lens SHAPE and lamp POSITION exactly. Change ONLY the COLOR OF EXISTING LENS GLASS AND FUNCTIONAL CORE MARKERS; no redesign, no extra artwork. Faction DECORATIVE emissive color is ICE-CYAN (preserve the NSDF cyan rails exactly). All decorative rails, dash groups, status dots and badge-border lamps use that ONE faction color. Functional colors are shared ACROSS factions: AMMO core cone/top rings and the two little round end-cap lenses are vivid BLUE, not faction color; REPAIR wrench/service glyph near local (0.355,0.12) and small round underside service lens near local (0.845,0.155) are vivid GREEN. Repair long rails and perimeter strips are DECORATIVE and MUST stay faction-colored, especially NSDF cyan; never turn those rails green. Weapon main optical-core module (TOP LEFT cell local x=.725..80, y=.45..555) is AMBER/GOLD, identical functional color across factions; ALL other little weapon lamps are faction-colored. Painted stars/dog heads, tactical markings and hazard bands MUST NOT glow and must NOT be recolored. Keep all worn metal, backgrounds including unused UV gutters, exact UV coordinates and quadrant sizes unchanged. Flat diffuse atlas only, no perspective, mockup, bloom halo, new text, labels, digits, watermark, outlines or frames. Keep four quadrant layout exact. Preserve NSDF cyan decorative lines when working on NSDF; only its functional blue ammo / green repair / amber weapon cores change.
